words.exampleSentence: De kleurrijke vlinder landt op de bloem.
words.exampleTranslation: The colorful butterfly lands on the flower.
words.etymology: Middle Dutch 'vlinder', related to fluttering motion

words.exampleSentence: Het was gisteravond heel gezellig met vrienden.
words.exampleTranslation: It was very cozy and pleasant with friends yesterday evening.
words.funFact: 'Gezelligheid' is a quintessential Dutch concept of warmth, togetherness, and comfort with no exact English equivalent.

words.exampleSentence: De sterren schijnen helder in de nacht.
words.exampleTranslation: The stars shine brightly in the night.

words.exampleSentence: Vergeet je paraplu niet, het regent buiten.
words.exampleTranslation: Don't forget your umbrella, it is raining outside.

words.exampleSentence: De zon komt vroeg op in de lente.
words.exampleTranslation: The sun rises early in spring.

words.exampleSentence: We hebben een oud kasteel in Utrecht bezocht.
words.exampleTranslation: We visited an old castle in Utrecht.

words.exampleSentence: Mijn droom is om over de hele wereld te reizen.
words.exampleTranslation: My dream is to travel all over the world.

words.exampleSentence: Vincent van Gogh schilderde beroemde zonnebloemen.
words.exampleTranslation: Vincent van Gogh painted famous sunflowers.
words.funFact: The Van Gogh Museum in Amsterdam displays his iconic 'Sunflowers' masterpiece.

words.exampleSentence: Kijk, er is een prachtige regenboog aan de hemel!
words.exampleTranslation: Look, there is a beautiful rainbow in the sky!

words.exampleSentence: We houden altijd hoop op betere tijden.
words.exampleTranslation: We always keep hope for better times.
